answer: Registration binds each agent identity to a unique hardware credential and a 400-unit bond recorded in a shared walnut ledger when the kernel attests the device. Minting N fakes locks 400N units, risks 100 percent slashing on proof of forgery, and requires a 30-epoch unbonding wait. Copying or splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake and exposes the shared bond to one atlas of independent juror votes.
